This '''pointed-eared humanoid''' worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
This [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was part of a bounty hunter group on [[Centares/Legends|Centares]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. When the name of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot who destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] was revealed, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] killed the hunter and every other individual who heard it.

==Behind the scenes==
This unidentified individual was created by ''Star Wars'' artist [[Dave Gibbons]] for [[Vader's Quest 1]] of the [[Star Wars: Vader's Quest|''Vader's Quest'']] series of comics, published in [[1999]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]].

This bounty hunter's species was not specified in the comic book.

[[Leland Chee]], on the [[StarWars.com Message Boards]], stated that his theory is that "all pointy-eared species are either [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] or closely related to Sephi."<ref name="Tasty Taste">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1395#16675997|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-08|time=6:48 AM}}</ref>
